basic_details.job_title: SGPGIMS Recruitment 2026 - Apply Online for Project Research Scientist and Project Technical Support-I Posts
basic_details.organization_name: Sanjay Gandhi Postgraduate Institute of Medical Sciences (SGPGIMS)
basic_details.post_name: Project Research Scientist -1 (NM) and Project Technical Support-I

age_limit.age_details: Max 35 years for Project Research Scientist, Max 28 years for Project Technical Support
age_limit.details: Project Research Scientist - I (Non-Medical): Maximum age limit is 35 years. Project Technical Support -1: Maximum age limit is 28 years.

qualification.education_qualification: Post Graduate Degree or Engineering/IT/CS Four-year Graduate Degree. For Project Technical Support: 10th + Diploma or Graduate Degree.
qualification.details: Project Research Scientist - I (Non-Medical): Post Graduate Degree, including the integrated PG degrees For Engineering /IT/CS - Four-year Graduate Degree Doctoral or M.Tech Degree in Bioinformatics/protein structure analysis/Computational Biology with experience in developing AI/ML-based modeling for healthcare applications, conducting integrative data analysis, and developing statistical models. Doctoral degree in Life Sciences, Biotechnology, Biochemistry, Molecular Biology, Neuroscience, or a related discipline, with prior research experience in cell culture and animal tissue culture studies. Hands-on experience in mouse model behavioral studies, drug screening, genotyping, molecular cloning, antibody characterization, and protein expression and characterization. Project Technical Support -1: 10th + Diploma (MLT/DMLT/ ITI or equivalent) + two Years experience in relevant subject/field. Three years' graduate degree in a relevant subject/field + one year experience in a relevant subject. M.Sc./DMLT or equivalent qualification with experience in clinical laboratory work, including patient sample collection, processing, and analysis, along with hands-on experience in mammalian cell culture. Knowledge and practical experience in bioinformatics, computational analysis, and relevant computer applications. M.Sc./DMLT or equivalent qualification with hands-on experience in animal handling and experimental animal studies. Experience in molecular biology techniques, including DNA/RNA isolation, PCR/qPCR, genotyping, protein analysis, and related laboratory procedures.

salary_details.pay_scale: Rs. 56000/-Pm + 20% HRA, as admissible / Rs. 18000/-Pm + 20% HRA, as admissible

how_to_apply: Candidates who wish to apply for SGPGIMS Various Posts Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below.
Read the official notification carefully before applying.
Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience.
Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs.
Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email.
Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification.
Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 10-10-2026.
Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for SGPGIMS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the SGPGIMS recruitment is 10-10-2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in the SGPGIMS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 4 vacancies announced for the positions of Project Research Scientist -1 (NM) and Project Technical Support-I.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for SGPGIMS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates can apply for these positions through email submission.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required for Project Research Scientist - I (Non-Medical)?
faq.answer: For Project Research Scientist - I (Non-Medical), a Post Graduate Degree or an Engineering/IT/CS Four-year Graduate Degree is required, along with specific research experience.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for Project Technical Support -1?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Project Technical Support -1 position is 28 years.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for Project Research Scientist - I (Non-Medical)?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for Project Research Scientist - I (Non-Medical) will receive Rs. 56000/- per month plus 20% HRA, as admissible.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for SGPGIMS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve shortlisting of candidates followed by a personal interview.

faq.question: Q8. Where is SGPGIMS located?
faq.answer: SGPGIMS is located in Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh, with the pincode 226014.

faq.question: Q9. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q10. What type of job is this recruitment for?
faq.answer: This is a project-based recruitment, offering opportunities in the research field.
